text:
Recommendation: Don't shut down the note app yet — keep it running and test one AI agent product with your existing customers before committing the whole team to a full pivot.
Why:
- Shutting off $16k MRR ($192k/year) with unknown runway could be fatal.
- Agent market and investor demand is unproven for you specifically: no product, buyer, or investor is named yet.
- With 2% monthly churn (~50-month average customer life), your 40 teams are a natural first audience for an agent add-on.
- Shutting down may breach existing contracts; a running, low-churn app can also be sold later.
Risks and unknowns:
- Splitting focus could slow the agent build past a real, short funding window.
- A genuine investor offer tied to a full pivot would change this calculus toward going all-in.
Next steps:
1. Within 1 week: calculate runway = cash / (full burn including payroll tax and benefits, minus $16k MRR). If runway is under 3 months, raise money first before pivoting.
2. Within 2 weeks: pitch one defined agent add-on to all 40 teams. Success is 5+ paid pilots; if fewer than 2 say yes, rethink the product rather than abandoning the app.
3. Over the next 90 days: keep 1 person running the app while 3 build the agent product. Continue if paid pilots grow; stop and reassess if churn doubles.
